{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders
# Also filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != '999999.99')]

# Check the final population
print(f"Final population size (completed and not QA): {len(df_filtered)}")

# Compute conversion rates by channel
df_filtered['revenue_float'] = df_filtered['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

conversion_rates = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract rates
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute raw difference: email - paid_search
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f"Conversion rate (email): {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
